task: Add Committee Secretary appointment and searchable dropdown to Project Details FacultyCommitteeCard, and relocate Committee Assignments from UsersPage into a dedicated Sidebar navigation item and page.
user_requests_addressed: On project details add secretary appointment, allowing instructors to assign a secretary.
Make the faculty search in committee assignment a searchable dropdown combobox with instant filtering and conflict badges.
Move committee assignment out of the Users page and into a dedicated Sidebar navigation item.

verification_evidence.client_targeted_tests: 36/36 PASS (FacultyCommitteeCard, AssignCommitteeDialog, CommitteeAssignmentsPage, Sidebar, Header, UsersPage)

learned_lessons: Defense committees strictly require 1 Adviser, 1 Secretary, and 3 Panelists (Chair + 2 Members). Course instructors cannot serve on committees.
Synchronizing secretaryId between Project and Team models ensures consistent state across project detail views and team committee overviews.
Using an accessible FacultySearchCombobox with sticky input and conflict mapping provides an intuitive, zero-confusion assignment UX.
Relocating committee assignments from /users to /committee-assignments cleanly decouples capstone academic management from user administration.
